name: Bulk discount slabs match the SRS tiers
description: The four SRS bulk discount slabs are configured and visible to an admin.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /Account/Login and sign in as admin@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2027

Assert the slab table lists exactly four rows, covering 10-15 connections at 25 percent, 15-25 at 50 percent, 25-50 at 75 percent, and 50 and above at 100 percent. If any slab is missing or carries a different rate, this test must fail.
Assert every one of the four slabs is shown as active, so the billing engine will pick one up. If a slab is inactive, this test must fail.
